eir.0070 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0070.t
	desc = eir.0070.desc
	theme = diplomacy
	cooldown = { years = 20 }
	left_portrait = {
		character = scope:eir_welsh_prince
		animation = personality_honorable
	}

	trigger = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		is_ai = no
		has_global_variable = eir_done_crowned
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_welsh_prince
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0070.a
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_celtic_brotherhood_modifier years = 8 }
		add_prestige = 100
		add_hook = { target = scope:eir_welsh_prince type = favor_hook }
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0070.b
		add_prestige = 25
		scope:eir_welsh_prince = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_gael_pride_opinion opinion = 15 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0070.c
		trigger = {
			diplomacy >= 8
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		spawn_army = {
			levies = 0
			men_at_arms = {
				type = bowmen
				stacks = 3
			}
			location = capital_province
			origin = capital_province
			inheritable = no
			name = eir_mercenary_company_name
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
	}
}
